records.location_name: AFAC Headquarters (Nelson Street)
records.notes: Weekly supplemental groceries. Choose one site and visit once a week (per Arlington County 2026 flyer). Home delivery for homebound clients: call 571-384-1448. Document questions: 571-384-1440. AFAC strives to provide every week: milk, eggs, one serving of protein (choice of chicken, ground beef, fish, or hot dogs), fresh fruit, fresh vegetables, cereal or oatmeal, canned goods, rice/pasta/dry beans, bread, baked goods.
records.raw_hours_text: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Tuesday and Thursday evenings: 6:00 – 7:00 PM; Saturday morning: 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM
records.raw_eligibility_text: To receive weekly groceries from AFAC, you must: (1) live in Arlington and (2) get a referral from an Arlington County social service agency. AFAC referrals last for 6 months ... To apply for AFAC services, you must provide ONE photo identification and ONE proof of your address in Arlington

services.description: If you are temporarily or permanently homebound due to a disability, recovering from a recent surgery, or are postpartum, and don't have someone to pick up your groceries from AFAC, call 571-384-1448 to ask about home delivery.
